judgment: Expanded TRAIN improves complete validation likelihood and reduces its gap from each model own training set, but full shape, voltage and time-tail distributions remain distinguishable. More updates partly improve prompt/baseline behavior without restoring the charge-PSD two-band structure. Keep the larger TRAIN and test one conditional residual flow beyond the frozen Gaussian base; no final response model is accepted.
boundaries: Same historical acquisition; artificial groups are not independent runs.
Equal exposure budget adds compute; only equal updates isolates sample-count change under this fixed recipe.
Representation and base statistics remain fitted on original2592; not the full expanded-method ceiling.
TRAIN gaps use each model own training population; no retraining uncertainty estimate.
Bootstrap is conditional on fitted classifiers and has no multiplicity correction.
Target density is not a G4-parent conditional response; increased REAL cost belongs in paper A.
No exact nearest copies is not proof of no memory.
